question: T04
stage: analytic predictions frozen before numerical evaluation

model.initialization: Fourier projection; common physical modal vector for each pair

metric: Euclidean physical (u,v) Fourier amplitude; L2 modal operator norm, not relative solution ranking

predictions.claim: Centered Gaussian q=(n+1/eta)^2 loses exactly T radius: bounded same-s operator iff r-r_prime >= T. Uncentered Gaussian endpoint fails without b-b_prime >= 2*T/abs(eta).
For high n and k*n -> 0: -(gamma(d_k)-gamma(n))/(k^4*n^6) -> 1/15. Euler -effective-rate defect/(dt*n^4) -> 1/2. RK4 analogous /(dt^4*n^10) -> 1/120.
Exact-time spectral interpolation with centered-Gaussian unit input class r=1/4 and output L2 at T=1/8 has O(k^4) uniform physical error, including Fourier projection tail.

checks.numeric_indicator: sup represented weighted physical matrix error; analytic tail separately bounded

predictions.claim: For the L2 unit band class, k^4*K^6*exp(T*gamma_max(K)) -> 0 is the absolute spatial convergence condition in the small cumulative-defect regime. K~c*sqrt(log(1/k)) converges for T*c^2<4 and has growing error witnesses for T*c^2>=4.

checks.input: unit continuous growth eigenvector at +K, common for both propagators

predictions.claim: Symbol maximum satisfies f_max^2=1/4+2*sqrt(6)/3; d_k(pi/k)=0. Tenfold seed reduction delays a fixed modal error threshold by log(10)/gamma.

excluded_claims: impossibility of all finite parameter improvements
verification_scope: Few direct modal calculations only; no PDE rerun, no parameter optimization, no historical trajectory access. Numerical checks support proofs and do not choose the claims.
